sanskrit: oṃ mahāgaṇapataye namaḥ || hariḥ oṃ || avighnamastu | śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
go brāhmaṇanṛpāṇāṃ ca śivaṃ bhavatu sarvadā ||
saṃ sevyate parodhamraste rudrā nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
yatra vā dṛśyate liṅgaṃ sarvatīrthāni tatra vai ||
ye smaranti virūpākṣaṃ te rudrā nātrasaṃśayaḥ ||
yaḥ kṣaṇaṃ vā muhūrtaṃ vā śarvamekaṃ na cintayet ||
teṣāṃ hi saphalaṃ janma kṛtārthāste narottamāḥ ||
sā cāṣṭāṃgī śivenoktā kāryā nityaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
tasmai deyaṃ tato grāhyaṃ sa ca pūjyo yathāhyaham ||
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati ||
tasyāhaṃ nityamātmasthaḥ sa ca nityaṃ mayi sthitaḥ ||
eṣā divā ca rātrau ca nityā śivagatāsmṛtiḥ ||
jihvāgre vartate yasya saphalāṃ tasya jīvitam ||
na tasya pīḍāṃ kurvanti tathā cānye'pi hiṃsakāḥ ||
datvā kiṃ labhate puṇyaṃ kṛtvā vā tatpratiśrayam ||
yoga yogin mahāyogin yogeśvara namo'stu te ||
sthāpitaṃ tena sarvaṃ syāt pūjitañca na saṃśayaḥ ||
brahmā pūjayate nityaṃ liṅgaṃ śailamayaṃ śubham ||
vasavaḥ kā* taṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayanti vidhānataḥ ||
tāmraṃ liṅgaṃ sadā kālaṃ bhaktyā devo divākaraḥ ||
